title: Earnings live updates: Cisco and Cerebras earnings point to strong AI demand, but their stocks are falling anyway
excerpt: The second quarter earnings season is beginning to wind down, with nearly 90% of S&P 500 (^GSPC) companies having already reported.
content_html:
Updated Wed, August 12, 2026 at 4:32 PM EDT 1 min read

The second quarter earnings season is beginning to wind down, with nearly 90% of S&P 500 (^GSPC) companies having already reported.

The takeaway from the quarter so far has been unbridled strength. According to FactSet data, second quarter earnings for S&P 500 companies are on pace to rise 50% year over year, the highest growth rate since 2021. Artificial intelligence has been the growth engine of that broad-based earnings growth, Bank of America strategists noted.

The next test comes this week from key players in different branches of the AI boom. Cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV), AI server maker Supermicro (SMCI), and chip equipment manufacturer Applied Materials (AMAT) are among the key companies reporting results this week.

content_html_zh:
更新于 2026 年 8 月 12 日星期三下午 4:32（美国东部时间） 阅读时间 1 分钟

第二季度财报季即将结束，近 90% 的标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 公司已发布财报。

迄今为止，本季度的成果是强劲的势头。 FactSet数据显示，标普500指数公司第二季度盈利有望同比增长50%，创2021年以来最高增速。 美国银行策略师指出，人工智能一直是广泛盈利增长的增长引擎。

本周，人工智能热潮不同领域的关键参与者将面临下一次考验。 云提供商 CoreWeave (CRWV)、人工智能服务器制造商 Supermicro (SMCI) 和芯片设备制造商 Applied Materials (AMAT) 是本周公布业绩的主要公司之一。
